mapper.select: SELECT current_database() AS db, version() AS ver
SELECT code FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT graph->>'xml' FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2} AND kind = 'device')
SELECT count(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND role = 'admin' AND enabled
SELECT actual_start FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('labos:user-role'))::text
SELECT id FROM capability WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}
SELECT id FROM device WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}
SELECT count(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = now() WHERE id = #{param1}
mapper.select: SELECT attr->>'maxIterations' AS n FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT input->'vars' AS vars FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT attendance FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(timeout_sec), 0) FROM device_method WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND device_id = #{param2}
SELECT parent_id FROM resource_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT resource_id FROM device_instance WHERE id = #{param1}
SELECT name FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT id FROM capability WHERE code = #{param1}
SELECT name FROM resource_node WHERE id = #{param1}
SELECT xml FROM workflow_graph_history WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND id = #{param3}

SELECT id AS "id", username AS "username", display_name AS "displayName", role AS "role", enabled AS "enabled", last_login_at AS "lastLoginAt", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id

SELECT w.id AS "id", w.code AS "code", w.name AS "name", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task') AS "nodeCount" FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.category = 'choreography' ORDER BY w.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT occurred_at AS "occurredAt", username AS "username", action AS "action", entity_type AS "entityType", entity_id AS "entityId", result AS "result", ip AS "ip", "before" AS "before", "after" AS "after" FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND (#{param2}::text IS NULL OR action = #{param2}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT id AS "id", node_count AS "nodeCount", edge_count AS "edgeCount", length(xml) AS "bytes", saved_at AS "savedAt" FROM workflow_graph_history WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.error_code AS "errorCode", r.input->>'quarantineReason' AS "reason", r.created_at::text AS "createdAt", (SELECT er.experiment_id FROM experiment_run_step s JOIN experiment_run er ON er.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND er.id = s.experiment_run_id WHERE s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.run_id = r.id LIMIT 1) AS "experimentId" FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.status = 'quarantined' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT id AS "id", manual_window_id AS "manualWindowId", run_id AS "runId", experiment_run_id AS "experimentRunId", operator AS "operator", decided_action AS "decidedAction", plate_barcode AS "plateBarcode", sample_id AS "sampleId", from_location AS "fromLocation", to_location AS "toLocation", result AS "result", note AS "note", created_at::text AS "createdAt" FROM intervention_record WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{param2}
mapper.update: UPDATE recovery_policy SET strategy = COALESCE(#{param3}::recovery_strategy, strategy), max_attempts = COALESCE(#{param4}, max_attempts), priority = COALESCE(#{param5}, priority), enabled = COALESCE(#{param6}, enabled), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT a.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", a.status AS "status", a.note AS "note", a.assignee AS "assignee", a.closed_at AS "closedAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", r.code AS "deviceCode", r.name AS "deviceName", ds.online AS "online", ds.last_heartbeat AS "lastHeartbeat", CASE WHEN ds.online = false THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ds.last_heartbeat))::bigint ELSE NULL END AS "offlineSec" FROM alert_state a LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON a.fingerprint = 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|' || r.id LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = r.id AND ds.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{param1} AND a.fingerprint LIKE 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT e.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", max(e.error_code_id) AS "codeId", max(e.resource_id) AS "resourceId", count(*) AS "hitCount", min(e.occurred_at) AS "firstAt", max(e.occurred_at) AS "lastAt", max(e.severity::text) AS "severity", (array_agg(e.outcome ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastOutcome", (array_agg(e.message ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastMessage", COALESCE(max(s.status), 'open') AS "state", max(s.assignee) AS "assignee", max(s.note) AS "note" FROM error_occurrence e LEFT JOIN alert_state s ON s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND s.fingerprint = e.fingerprint WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.severity::text <> 'info' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.fingerprint ORDER BY "hitCount" DESC, "lastAt" DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM error_code WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}) AS "codeExists", (SELECT count(*) FROM error_occurrence e JOIN error_code c ON c.id = e.error_code_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.code = #{param2}) AS "historyHits", (SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code c ON c.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.enabled AND p.priority < #{param3} AND (p.error_code_id IS NULL OR c.code = #{param2})) AS "shadowed"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, username, display_name, role, password_hash, salt) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6})

INSERT INTO alert_state (tenant_id, fingerprint, status, assignee, note, acked_at, closed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'acked' THEN now() END, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'closed' THEN now() END, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, assignee = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.assignee, alert_state.assignee), note = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.note, alert_state.note), acked_at = COALESCE(alert_state.acked_at, EXCLUDED.acked_at), closed_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'closed' THEN now() ELSE alert_state.closed_at END, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: INSERT INTO position_evidence (tenant_id, plate_barcode, resource_id, evidence_type, run_id, operator, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}) RETURNING id

WITH nd AS ( SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", estimate_sec AS "manual", resource_id AS "resourceId", params->>'protocol_name' AS "method", COALESCE(seq, 2147483647) AS ord, id FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' ), hist AS ( SELECT cmd.method, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cmd.finished_at - cmd.sent_at))) AS p50, count(*) AS n FROM run_command cmd WHERE cmd.tenant_id = #{param1} AND cmd.method IN (SELECT "method" FROM nd WHERE "method" IS NOT NULL) AND cmd.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND cmd.sent_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cmd.method ) SELECT nd."nodeKey", nd."name", nd."manual", nd."resourceId", nd."method", hist.p50 AS "p50", hist.n AS "n", (SELECT max(dm.estimate_sec) FROM device_method dm WHERE dm.method = nd."method" AND dm.estimate_sec > 0) AS "devEst" FROM nd LEFT JOIN hist ON hist.method = nd."method" ORDER BY nd.ord, nd.id

INSERT INTO intervention_record (tenant_id, manual_window_id, run_id, experiment_run_id, operator, decided_action, plate_barcode, sample_id, from_location, to_location, result, note) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6}, #{param7}, #{param8}, #{param9}, #{param10}, #{param11}, #{param12}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role = COALESCE(#{param3}, role), enabled = COALESCE(#{param4}, enabled), password_hash = COALESCE(#{param5}, password_hash), salt = COALESCE(#{param6}, salt) WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.run_id AS "runId", n.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", n.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.run_no AS "runNo", res.code AS "resCode", GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id LEFT JOIN resource_node res ON res.id = n.resource_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.attendance AS "attendance", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "total", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'completed') AS "done", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'manual') AS "manual", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'failed') AS "failed" FROM run r LEFT JOIN run_node n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.status = 'running' GROUP BY r.id, r.run_no, r.attendance, r.actual_start ORDER BY r.actual_start DESC

SELECT id AS "id", run_no AS "runNo", run_type AS "runType", pause_kind AS "pauseKind", pause_reason AS "pauseReason", pause_node_key AS "pauseNodeKey", status::text AS "status", priority AS "priority", attendance AS "attendance", actual_start AS "actualStart", actual_end AS "actualEnd", created_at AS "createdAt", input::text AS "input" FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT rn.id AS "id", rn.node_key AS "nodeKey", rn.name AS "name", rn.status::text AS "status", rn.attempt AS "attempt", rn.resource_id AS "resourceId", rn.capability_id AS "capabilityId", rn.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", res.code AS "resourceCode", level AS "level", parent_node_id AS "parentNodeId", step_seq AS "stepSeq", loop_index AS "loopIndex", input->>'reason' AS "reason", rn.error_code AS "errorCode" FROM run_node rn LEFT JOIN resource_node res ON res.id = rn.resource_id WHERE rn.run_id = #{param1} ORDER BY COALESCE(rn.parent_node_id, rn.id), rn.loop_index, rn.level, COALESCE(rn.step_seq, 0), rn.id

SELECT occurred_at AS "at", event_type AS "type", payload::text AS "payload" FROM run_event WHERE aggregate_type = 'run' AND aggregate_id = #{param1} ORDER BY COALESCE((payload->>'seq')::int, 0) LIMIT 100
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' ORDER BY id
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", status::text AS "status", error_code AS "errorCode" FROM run_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND run_id = #{param2} AND level = 0 AND loop_index = 0

SELECT id AS "id", node_key AS "nodeKey", name AS "name", status::text AS "status", level AS "level", parent_node_id AS "parentNodeId", step_seq AS "stepSeq", resource_id AS "resourceId", loop_index AS "loopIndex", actual_start AS "actualStart", actual_end AS "actualEnd", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (actual_end - actual_start)) * 1000 AS "durMs" FROM run_node WHERE run_id = #{param1} AND actual_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_node_id, id), level, COALESCE(step_seq, 0), id

SELECT p.id AS "id", COALESCE(ec.code, '*') AS "code", p.scope AS "scope", p.strategy::text AS "strategy", p.max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", p.priority AS "priority", p.enabled AS "enabled", COALESCE(p.params->>'origin', 'manual') AS "origin" FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code ec ON ec.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY p.priority, p.id

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.run_type AS "runType", r.status::text AS "status", r.priority AS "priority", r.attendance AS "attendance", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.actual_end AS "actualEnd", r.created_at AS "createdAt", (SELECT count(*) FROM run_node n WHERE n.run_id = r.id AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "nodeCount" FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", n.status::text AS "status", n.attempt AS "attempt", n.resource_id AS "resourceId", n.input->>'reason' AS "reason", (SELECT string_agg(c2.method, ' → ' ORDER BY c2.command_seq) FROM run_command c2 WHERE c2.run_node_id = n.id) AS "steps" FROM run_node n WHERE n.run_id = #{param1} AND n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status NOT IN ('completed', 'skipped') ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.run_no AS "runNo", r.status::text AS "status", r.actual_start AS "actualStart", r.actual_end AS "actualEnd", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.actual_end - r.actual_start)) AS "durationSec", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0) AS "total", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'completed') AS "done", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'manual') AS "manual", count(n.id) FILTER (WHERE n.level = 0 AND n.loop_index = 0 AND n.status = 'failed') AS "failed" FROM run r LEFT JOIN run_node n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.workflow_id = #{param2} GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT GREATEST(0, COALESCE(n.estimate_sec, 0) - COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - n.actual_start)), 0)) AS "remain" FROM run_node n JOIN run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.resource_id = #{param2} AND n.level = 0 AND n.status = 'running' AND r.status = 'running' ORDER BY "remain" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name" FROM capability ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
